title: Email Suppression List: Why You Should Not Delete Opt-Outs
meta_description: An email suppression list keeps opt-outs out of your next send. The UK ICO says you should not delete from it; CAN-SPAM limits transfers of opted-out addresses.

image.takeaway: UK ICO guidance says you should not delete a person's information from a suppression list.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on email suppression lists: UK ICO guidance says you should not delete a person's information from a suppression list.
